description: This file is a Markdown documentation source file for the 'Route' class in a Playwright API reference. It contains class description, method summaries, usage examples, and change notes.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Handles network route operations such as aborting, continuing, fallback, fetching, and fulfilling network requests.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the route's request, optionally specifying an error code.

methods.name: continue
methods.description: Sends route's request to the network with optional overrides such as URL, method, headers, and postData.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Continues route's request with optional overrides, allowing other matching handlers to be invoked first.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Performs the request and fetches the result without fulfilling it, allowing response modification.

methods.name: fulfill
methods.description: Fulfills route's request with a specified response, such as static data or a file.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Returns the original request associated with the route.
